Stone's season chart issued August 30, 2014 at the reduction to 53, over the 53 only; game_depth_chart.json in this folder is the released game input and the two files are changed together. Every player on the 53 holds a chart place; the four reserve/injured players and the seven practice-squad players are not on the chart.
as_of: October 5, 2014, after the Week 5 game against Pittsburgh (availability notes for Trawick and Christian Jones; no order change since October 4; the Week 5 inactives applied as set; the Week 6 inactives are Stone's after the October 6 and 7 exams)

sources: The August 28 personnel packet's season depth chart baseline (Regular-season Week 1.md: Adams X, Thielen H, Hawkins Z; Lewis, Kelce, Jensen; Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Kreiter snapping; Hawkins returning kicks and punts with Hurns the second punt returner; Nicks back to X and Adams to Z only after medical clearance and a full practice week); the frozen August 27 Atlanta chart (Preseason_Games/Game_04/depth_chart.json) for every other order; the current roster for control and availability; the August 30 reduction (Roster_Decisions/final_roster_cuts.md) for the 53. Earlier: career/2013/depth_chart.json (Git 781213a, carried order); current career/2013/roster.md; current career/2014/finances/player_contracts/contract_status.md; career/2014/free_agency/signings.md; ledger Entries 79 and 85 through 89; Entry 94 (league year opened); Entry 95 (March 2014 free-agency replay); Entry 108 (2014 draft and undrafted signings); Entry 110 (Rackley traded); Entry 111 (Stone's May 12 starting roles; rookie minicamp and Phase Two closed)
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. The packet's baseline sets the starting eleven on offense, the snapper and the returners; the Atlanta chart's order is carried for everyone else, minus the players who left on August 30. A player out under a medical instruction is listed last in his group while out and is on the inactive list (Poyer, on his hold, is last among the defensive backs for Week 5; Butler, released October 2, is placed above him and is inactive by Stone's decision; Stone decided Nicks's X question on October 4: Adams starts X and Nicks is the fifth receiver and the X relief on prepared series only, not a starting promotion; Hoskins keeps the fourth tight-end place); a player on reserve/injured is off the chart; his return to the order is Stone's decision on clearance under the packet's condition. The roles field carries the kernel roles (passer, placekicker, punt, kick_return, punt_return) and, from Week 5, the two defensive-back seat roles kernel 2014.6 reads (nickel: Bouye; outside_reserve: Ball, the first corner to replace an outside starter), transcribed from Stone's Dime decision in the Week 5 packet; Hurns is the second punt returner by Stone's instruction and is not given the kernel role, which the kernel reads as the first returner. Each change is logged in career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/depth_chart.md.
note: The released game input is career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/game_depth_chart.json (runtime/seasons.py names it as the required 2014 input; runtime/week_inputs.py reads it as Stone's order). This working copy mirrors it with the contract flags, availability notes, the removed-player history and the update log.
